desc: The mid-match spawns on a clock (scripts/match/timed_spawns.gd, docs/SPAWNS.md): each comes at a fixed share of the session at a fixed place, and is called out (map ping and a feed line with the seconds left) warn_s before it appears and again 10 s before.
_glimmer: the Glimmerkin, at one outer-island wild Boki spot picked from the match seed; at: share of the session, warn_s: seconds of warning
_warden: the Watcher, at the Heart on the center island
